description: Reference carry across a named team (Newcastle United) set in turn 0.

turns.query: Where did Newcastle United finish in the 2023-2024 Premier League table?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_rank FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND tss_team = 'Newcastle United';

turns.query: And how many points did they finish on?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_points FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND tss_team = 'Newcastle United';

turns.query: How many goals did they score across the season?
